name: Blood Curse of the Fallen Puppet
description:
When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you drops to 0 hit points, you can take a Reaction to instill that creature with a final act of aggression. The creature immediately makes one weapon attack against a target of your choice within its range.
	**Amplify**: You can first cause the cursed creature to move up to half its speed, and you grant a bonus to its attack roll equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).
